bullets: Added Muse Spark 1.3 to the Freebuff model catalog, dropping 1.2 from the free list while keeping it paid-only on all surfaces.
Added a streak status line to the CLI landing screen and chat header showing today's Freebucks bonus and the next reset time.
Added the Desktop surface as a third option on the onboarding questionnaire alongside Web.
Added a deal-ending-soon badge to the GLM 5.3 Flash row warning that its 15/hr price ends Sep 30.
Updated the chat header to pick the Freebuff wordmark variant by fitted width instead of a fixed terminal width breakpoint.
Updated MCP tool result handling to keep text resources as JSON values and degrade non-image binary resources to descriptive text.
Updated Undici body-terminated stream errors to be treated as transient network errors so Node hosts no longer error on dropped model streams.
Added start and end hooks around compaction passes in the SDK and agent runtime.
Added structured message support with images to the steering drain hook, letting hosts inject image-bearing messages into a running turn.
Removed the bookmark gate analytics events from the Freebuff event enum.
Bumped the onboarding tally version to rebuild aggregates after folding Facebook answers into the Instagram/TikTok referral chip.
Clamped per-model output caps during compaction so a 6,000-token request against a 4,096-token limit is clamped and truncated handoffs are rejected.
Added Facebook spellings to the Instagram/TikTok referral chip write-in pattern so Facebook answers count under the tiktok id.
